districtFact: Northshore School District publishes a one-page Family Calendar that is especially useful for families because it separates most-grade start dates, elementary-only conference early dismissals, weekly Wednesday early release, teacher grading/non-student days, commencements, grade 9-11 early dismissals near graduation, and emergency make-up days.

about.title: About Northshore School District
about.content: Northshore School District, commonly called NSD, serves students in Puget Sound communities including Bothell, Woodinville, Kenmore, and surrounding areas. Its Family Calendar highlights the dates that most affect household planning: first and last school days, weekly early release, elementary conference early dismissals, breaks, graduation dates, and emergency make-up days.

about.title: District Calendar and School-Level Schedules
about.content: This page covers districtwide NSD dates from the Family Calendar. Families should still check their school for bell schedules, first-day and last-day instructions, half-day schedules, transportation updates, athletics, performances, testing, early childhood calendars, religious and cultural observance calendars, and campus-specific events.

planningTips.title: Northshore Calendar Notes
content: NSD marks the first day, last day, and half day with a note that schools communicate schedules directly to families.
All Wednesdays beginning in early September are regular early-release Wednesdays unless another note applies.
Elementary conference early dismissals are elementary-only dates and do not necessarily apply to secondary schools.
Emergency make-up days are added to the end of the school year if needed, so late-June plans should be checked against district updates.

districtFaqs.q: Does Northshore School District have Wednesday early release?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. NSD's Family Calendar states that all Wednesdays beginning in early September dismiss 1.5 hours early for students unless noted.

districtFaqs.q: Do elementary conference early dismissals apply to all NSD students?
districtFaqs.a: No. NSD labels those dates as elementary schools only. Secondary families should check school-level calendars for separate schedule changes.

districtFaqs.q: Can the Northshore last day of school change?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. NSD lists emergency make-up days that may be added to the end of the school year if weather or another closure requires additional days.

districtFaqs.q: Where can families find translated NSD calendars?
districtFaqs.a: NSD publishes translated Family Calendar PDFs on its calendar page. MySchoolDates links the available translated versions for reviewed school years when provided.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify last-minute Northshore changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Northshore School District calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with NSD.
